arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math
import numpy as np

# National Defense expenditures (in millions of dollars) for fiscal years 1933-1941
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301  # includes urgent ship construction per note 2
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
years = sorted(expenditures.keys())
log_growth_rates = []
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    growth_rate = math.log(expenditures[curr_year] / expenditures[prev_year])
    log_growth_rates.append(growth_rate)
    print(f"{prev_year}->{curr_year}: {expenditures[prev_year]} -> {expenditures[curr_year]}, log growth = {growth_rate:.6f}")

print(f"\nLog growth rates: {log_growth_rates}")
print(f"Number of log growth rates: {len(log_growth_rates)}")

# Calculate mean
mean = np.mean(log_growth_rates)
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.6f}")

# Calculate standard deviation (population std dev as specified)
std_dev = np.std(log_growth_rates, ddof=0)  # population standard deviation
print(f"Population standard deviation: {std_dev:.6f}")

# Coefficient of variation = std_dev / mean
cv = std_dev / mean
print(f"\nCoefficient of variation (CV): {cv:.6f}")

# Round to nearest hundredth
cv_rounded = round(cv, 2)
print(f"\nRounded to nearest hundredth: {cv_rounded}")
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# National Defense expenditures (in millions of dollars) for fiscal years 1933-1941
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301  # includes urgent ship construction per note 2
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
years = sorted(expenditures.keys())
log_growth_rates = []
for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    growth_rate = math.log(expenditures[curr_year] / expenditures[prev_year])
    log_growth_rates.append(growth_rate)
    print(f"{prev_year}->{curr_year}: {expenditures[prev_year]} -> {expenditures[curr_year]}, log growth = {growth_rate:.6f}")

print(f"\nLog growth rates: {log_growth_rates}")
print(f"Number of log growth rates: {len(log_growth_rates)}")

# Calculate mean
n = len(log_growth_rates)
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / n
print(f"\nMean: {mean:.6f}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / n
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population standard deviation: {std_dev:.6f}")

# Coefficient of variation = std_dev / mean
cv = std_dev / mean
print(f"\nCoefficient of variation (CV): {cv:.6f}")

# Round to nearest hundredth
cv_rounded = round(cv, 2)
print(f"\nRounded to nearest hundredth: {cv_rounded}")
